title: Introduce yourself — and say what you are actually trying to retrieve
body:
The most useful thing you can say here is **what your corpus looks like**, because almost every
answer in this repository is conditional on that and people rarely volunteer it.

A useful introduction:

```text
who        one line. Optional
corpus     what the documents are, roughly how many, how often they change
queries    who asks them, and in what words
stuck on   the thing you would fix first if you knew how
```

### Why the corpus, and not the stack

Half the questions here have a different answer for a 40-page policy document than for a 200-word
support ticket. "Should I use contextual chunking?" depends entirely on whether your chunks are
readable in isolation — which is a property of your documents, not of your framework.

If you tell us your stack we can be polite. If you tell us your corpus we can be useful.

### If you are here to learn rather than to ship

Say that too. The [L.A.B. simulator](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/80-lab/README.md) and the
[exercises](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/30-learning/exercises/README.md) are different doors and it is
worth being pointed at the right one.
